title: WorkspacesCloseResult
description: Result of the workspaces.close JSON-RPC method: the id of the workspace that is gone. Its tabs, and their panes, went with it — a tab has no meaning outside a workspace (ON DELETE CASCADE). The result carries the id and nothing else on purpose: there is no object left to describe, and a copy of the row as it was would be a fact about a thing that no longer exists.
